summary: 8/8 criteria exercised via 8 browser checks (no API-bearing criteria — all IPPS Setu data is mocked in the frontend, so no backend pytest lane applies). All checks pass after fixing check methodology (measurement-timing artifact) and selector corrections; no application bugs found.

checks.criterion: Application status timeline circles are perfectly aligned horizontally with equal spacing
checks.name: timeline-dots-aligned
checks.evidence: On /startup/applications, all 5 .timeline-node-dot elements in application-timeline-APP-2024-002 share one unique centre-Y (measured via single synchronous evaluate() call after waiting for the 0.25s page-mount animation to settle) and consecutive centre-X gaps are equal within tolerance. NOTE: first attempt using sequential locator.boundingBox() calls falsely reported misalignment (e.g. [378,378,378,371,371]) — root cause was the .page-enter CSS mount animation (translateY 8px->0 over 250ms) being sampled at different instants per sequential call, not a real layout bug; confirmed via single in-page evaluate() returning identical top=360.375 for all 5 dots.

checks.criterion: Timeline connecting lines start and end at circle centres and stay aligned at other widths
checks.name: timeline-responsive-widths
checks.evidence: Re-checked dot centre-Y uniqueness and equal centre-X gaps at 1440px, 1024px and 768px viewports on /startup/applications; passed at all three widths after settling the mount animation before measuring.

checks.criterion: Each timeline circle contains a stage-appropriate icon and states stay distinct
checks.name: timeline-icons-and-states
checks.evidence: Each of the 5 .timeline-node-dot elements contains exactly 1 svg. Classes confirmed: Submitted/Screening='completed', Evaluation='active', Shortlisted/Pilot='pending'. Computed backgroundColor/borderColor differ pairwise across completed/active/pending (three distinct styles).

checks.criterion: Stage labels are centred under their own circle
checks.name: timeline-labels-centered
checks.evidence: For each of the 5 .timeline-node items, |dot centre-X - label centre-X| <= 4px.

checks.criterion: Header branding text 'INNOVATION PROCUREMENT PLATFORM' is fully visible, not cropped
checks.name: header-branding-not-cropped
checks.evidence: Ran against APP_URL ingress (https://ipps-setu-dev.preview.emergentagent.com) per ingress-path rule. .sidebar-logo-text span scrollWidth <= clientWidth on both /startup/dashboard and /gov/dashboard at 1440px and 1280px widths; full phrase text confirmed present.

checks.criterion: Interactive cards and buttons have clear, subtle hover states
checks.name: hover-states-visible
checks.evidence: Hover changed computed transform and/or boxShadow (polled within 2s) for: .kpi-card (dashboard), application .card (/startup/applications), .challenge-card (/startup/marketplace), expert-card-* (/startup/experts), .btn-primary, and .sidebar-item nav entry.

checks.criterion: No layout cropping, overlap or console errors across the app
checks.name: no-console-errors-across-pages
checks.evidence: Visited /, /login, /startup/dashboard, /startup/marketplace, /startup/applications, /startup/experts, /startup/experts/EXP-006, /gov/dashboard, /gov/challenges, /gov/evaluation, /gov/challenges/create — zero console 'error' events and zero HTTP responses with status >= 400 captured across the whole run.

checks.criterion: Existing flows still work after the polish changes
checks.name: proposal-and-mentorship-flow
checks.evidence: Full regression: marketplace -> apply -> 3-step proposal (Solution/Pilot Plan/Team&Review, tscheck- fixture data) -> submit -> redirected to /startup/applications with new APP-2024-0xx card visible; then /startup/experts -> Request Mentorship modal -> send -> My Mentorships tab shows card status 'Requested' -> advanced to 'Scheduled' -> 'Completed' -> Mentorship Outcomes form filled and saved, outcome block rendered.
